variable_id.description: Stable T2 entry ID, preserved from the historical registry.

variable.description: Existing variable key; retained without asserting a verified ontology or dataset match.

label.description: Short human-readable name of the intended variable.

quantity.description: Physical or contextual quantity intended; unresolved composites are named explicitly.

unit.description: Intended native unit, not an assertion that the candidate dataset supplies it. Blank if unresolved.

temporal_statistic.description: Temporal statistic required; an unresolved aggregation must be resolved before use.

hazard_type.description: Named hazard when applicable; blank for contextual variables.

scenario_type.description: Historical scenario identity, preserved; not a resolved time interval.

reference_period.description: Explicit time interval after review; blank in this migration.

context_id.description: Applicable geographic/context identity after review; blank in this migration.

mcda_role.description: Proposed routing for migration review; priority does not mean ready to score.

concern_id.description: Candidate shared concern for overlap review; not proof of interchangeability.

candidate_dataset_id.description: Historical T1 pointer retained for audit, not a verified binding.

dataset_id.description: Reserved for a verified context-resolved T1/BIND dataset; empty in this migration.

binding_status.description: Verification of intended quantity against candidate dataset.

classification_id.description: Reserved for an accepted classification identifier; blank until a tested acceptance route exists.

classification_version.description: Exact accepted classification version; blank in this migration.

classification_status.description: No accepted calibration is claimed by the migration.

readiness.description: Analytical readiness, distinct from human finding review. No ready state in this schema.

blockers.description: Quantity, data or calibration questions that must be resolved before analytical use.
